input.quote: (k) REPRESENTATION BY COUNSEL. Each party acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to be represented by separate independent counsel in the negotiation of this Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance obligation; the only reference to "insurance" is in the fees/taxes clause (p0051) allocating shipping and insurance charges to Licensee. Licensor hosts the platform and handles Licensee trading/account data, so the playbook requires standard coverages (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' comp) with certificates on request. Inserted as new subsection (l) at the end of General Provisions, before the execution paragraph.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, since Licensor hosts the Platform and handles our trading and account data but the Agreement carries no coverage requirement. Our position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; we can discuss E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence and US$2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than US$2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than US$5,000,000 covering Licensor's processing, hosting or storage of Licensee's data; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide Licensee with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request.
